description: Zealthix is an AI native comprehensive Healthcare Infrastructure Platform for Payers/Insurers to be able to offer seamless healthcare to their customers. It has two flagship modules, ZyncFlo, AgenticAI based unified IPD claim management platform and Zive, Healthcare deliver as a service for Insurers to be able to launch OPD Insurance with unparalleled efficiency and innovation. ZyncFlo enables payers to manage IPD claims seamlessly across network of hospitals. By leveraging Generative AI and Machine Learning, ZyncFlo digitizes and intelligently processes discharge summaries and clinical documents - automatically extracting and assigning accurate ICD codes, identifying approved procedures, matching billed amounts against contracted pricing, and cross-verifying submitted claims against policy inclusions, exclusions, waiting periods, sublimits, and proportionate deduction rules. This creates an automated adjudication layer that significantly reduces manual effort, accelerates claim processing, minimizes leakage, and delivers transparent, consistent outcomes for both payers and hospitals. Zive empowers payers to launch OPD insurance products rapidly by offering OPD coverage as a fully managed service. It provides a ready-to-deploy module with embedded rules engines, network integration, claims workflows, and real-time verification - allowing insurers to go live in weeks rather than months, without building complex internal infrastructure. Together, ZyncFlo and Zive form a unified, AI-first platform that bridges the divide between payers and hospitals, turning fragmented, error-prone claim workflows into intelligent, automated, and scalable processes. The result is faster settlements, improved compliance, lower costs, and stronger stakeholder trust - enabling the next generation of healthcare claim management in India. Zealthix Health Cloud Exchange, a middleware integrates disparate Health systems and providers in India. Zealthix follows global standards such as FHIR, LOINC, ICD10 and SNOMED CT and also helps providers comply with Govt initiatives such as ABDM , NHCX and ONDC in line with standards released by NRCeS.
